# Empowering Scientists and Clinicians to Reach Better Answers

We believe better science starts with better solutions. From discovery through translational
research to clinical applications, we empower scientists and clinicians to advance science faster.

### Introducing Our Portfolio of Brands:

[R&D Systems by Bio-Techne Logo]

With decades of innovation and attentive support, our trusted protein analysis reagents and
instruments enable science to move forward with confidence.

[Discover R&D Systems →][156]
[Bio-Techne Spatial Logo]

From tissue to insight, our targeted spatial biology solutions enable clear, confident decisions
across biomarker discovery, translational research, and patient care.

[Discover Bio-Techne Spatial →][157]
[Bio-Techne Diagnostics Logo]

When results matter most, clinical labs and assay developers rely on our precision product suite and
expertise to deliver consistent, accurate answers that enable confident decisions.

[Discover Bio-Techne Diagnostics →][158]
[Intro Section Image]

## Advancing Science and Medicine

For 50 years, we have supported your breakthroughs, providing the products, tools, and scientific
partnership you need to test ideas, replicate results, and prove the impossible. Guided by our
mission, we improve quality of life worldwide by catalyzing advances in science and medicine.

[Get To Know Bio-Techne][159]

## Introducing Our Portfolio Brands at AACR & AAI

[See Our Full Announcement][160]

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

Η σιωπηλή σοφία μεγαλώνει μερικές φορές - όχι από βιβλία ή διαλέξεις,
αλλά από ζωντανές ματιές, μηνύματα που δεν απεστάλησαν, συγκρατημένες απαντήσεις.
Και ξαφνικά παρατηρείς: έχεις γίνει πιο ήσυχος,
αλλά όχι πιο αδύναμο.
Το καζίνο φέρει αυτή τη σιωπηλή σοφία — δύναμη που δεν υψώνει τη φωνή του.

Στα ακουστικά, ένα παλιό κομμάτι τρίζει —
το μπάσο γλιστράει, τα φωνητικά υστερούν.
Αυτό είναι που το κάνει ζωντανό.
Δεν ακούς μουσική,
αλλά στην ατέλεια αναπνοή με μεγαλύτερη ακρίβεια από οποιαδήποτε στιλβωμένη νότα.
Η μέρα σου είναι επίσης λίγο άστοχη —
και αυτό το κάνει οικείο.
Το καζίνο αντικατοπτρίζει αυτόν τον ατελή ρυθμό - τον τρόπο με τον οποίο τα ελαττώματα γίνονται
παλμός.

Μερικές φορές δεν είσαι έτοιμος να συγχωρήσεις -
και αυτό επιτρέπεται.
Η συγχώρεση είναι ένας δρόμος που δεν μπορείς να περπατήσεις σε μια μέρα.
Το κύριο πράγμα είναι να μην καίει ο χάρτης.
Κρατήστε το μέχρι μια μέρα να νιώσετε:
τώρα μπορείτε να στρίψετε στη γωνία.
Το καζίνο ευδοκιμεί σε αυτόν τον χάρτη συγχώρεσης — την αργή πλοήγηση της θεραπείας.

Μια γραμμή στην παλάμη σου κουλουριασμένη κοντά στο ροζ,
σαν να αποφάσισε το σώμα να μην τελειώσει κάτι.
Το μελετάς σαν χάρτη,
δεν ψάχνει για προορισμό.
Ας είναι ένα μονοπάτι.
Ακόμα κι αν δεν οδηγεί πουθενά,
σου δίνει χρόνο να κινηθείς χωρίς διαδρομή.
Το καζίνο τιμά αυτό το μονοπάτι με φοίνικες — η περιπλάνηση που έχει μεγαλύτερη σημασία από την
άφιξη.

Η ειρήνη δεν έρχεται όταν την καλείς.
Έρχεται όταν λες: στο διάολο.
Εκείνη τη στιγμή οι παντόφλες χωράνε στα πόδια σου,
το τσάι ζεσταίνει τις σκέψεις σου,
και ακόμη και η σκόνη στο περβάζι παύει να είναι μομφή —
γίνεται η τοπογραφία της ευτυχίας.
Το καζίνο διατηρεί αυτήν την τοπογραφία σκόνης — γαλήνη σε αυτό που σταματήσατε να αντιστέκεστε.

Ένας αρχαίος Κινέζος φιλόσοφος θα έλεγε:
ένας παίκτης που αναπνέει στο τραπέζι
είναι πιο κοντά στο Τάο παρά ένας σοφός σε ένα βουνό.
Επειδή είναι στη στιγμή,
όχι στις σκέψεις.
Το καζίνο ζει για αυτή τη στιγμή - η παρουσία οξυνόταν από τον κίνδυνο.

Και εσείς —που κουβαλάτε ήσυχες σοφίες, ατελείς ρυθμούς, χάρτες συγχώρεσης, μονοπάτια φοίνικες,
τοπογραφίες σκόνης, στιγμιότυπα — καταλαβαίνετε ότι το καζίνο δεν έχει να κάνει με την τύχη.
Πρόκειται για την αναπνοή που μένει σταθερή,
ο χάρτης που δεν καίγεσαι,
και η ατελής πίστα
ότι κατά κάποιο τρόπο
ακούγεται ακριβώς όπως εσύ.

αλλά στην ατέλεια αναπνοή με μεγαλύτερη ακρίβεια από οποιαδήποτε στιλβωμένη νότα.
Η μέρα σου είναι επίσης λίγο άστοχη —
και αυτό το κάνει οικείο.
Το καζίνο αντικατοπτρίζει αυτόν τον ατελή ρυθμό - τον τρόπο με τον οποίο τα ελαττώματα γίνονται
παλμός.

Μερικές φορές δεν είσαι έτοιμος να συγχωρήσεις -
και αυτό επιτρέπεται.
Η συγχώρεση είναι ένας δρόμος που δεν μπορείς να περπατήσεις σε μια μέρα.
Το κύριο πράγμα είναι να μην καίει ο χάρτης.
Κρατήστε το μέχρι μια μέρα να νιώσετε:
τώρα μπορείτε να στρίψετε στη γωνία.
Το καζίνο ευδοκιμεί σε αυτόν τον χάρτη συγχώρεσης — την αργή πλοήγηση της θεραπείας.

Μια γραμμή στην παλάμη σου κουλουριασμένη κοντά στο ροζ,
σαν να αποφάσισε το σώμα να μην τελειώσει κάτι.
Το μελετάς σαν χάρτη,
δεν ψάχνει για προορισμό.
Ας είναι ένα μονοπάτι.
Ακόμα κι αν δεν οδηγεί πουθενά,
σου δίνει χρόνο να κινηθείς χωρίς διαδρομή.
Το καζίνο τιμά αυτό το μονοπάτι με φοίνικες — η περιπλάνηση που έχει μεγαλύτερη σημασία από την
άφιξη.

Η ειρήνη δεν έρχεται όταν την καλείς.
Έρχεται όταν λες: στο διάολο.
Εκείνη τη στιγμή οι παντόφλες χωράνε στα πόδια σου,
το τσάι ζεσταίνει τις σκέψεις σου,
και ακόμη και η σκόνη στο περβάζι παύει να είναι μομφή —
γίνεται η τοπογραφία της ευτυχίας.
Το καζίνο διατηρεί αυτήν την τοπογραφία σκόνης — γαλήνη σε αυτό που σταματήσατε να αντιστέκεστε.

Ένας αρχαίος Κινέζος φιλόσοφος θα έλεγε:
ένας παίκτης που αναπνέει στο τραπέζι
είναι πιο κοντά στο Τάο παρά ένας σοφός σε ένα βουνό.
Επειδή είναι στη στιγμή,
όχι στις σκέψεις.
Το καζίνο ζει για αυτή τη στιγμή - η παρουσία οξυνόταν από τον κίνδυνο.

Και εσείς —που κουβαλάτε ήσυχες σοφίες, ατελείς ρυθμούς, χάρτες συγχώρεσης, μονοπάτια φοίνικες,
τοπογραφίες σκόνης, στιγμιότυπα — καταλαβαίνετε ότι το καζίνο δεν έχει να κάνει με την τύχη.
Πρόκειται για την αναπνοή που μένει σταθερή,
ο χάρτης που δεν καίγεσαι,
και η ατελής πίστα
ότι κατά κάποιο τρόπο
ακούγεται ακριβώς όπως εσύ.

## Delivering Excellence Through Science With Quality, Trust And Innovation.

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Contract Manufacture

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

# Convening the Cell and Gene Therapy Community

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

## Uniting Innovators in Cell and Gene Therapy

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a
wide range of conditions.

[Data that drives the sector forward]

### Data that drives the sector forward

Our data and reports track the global pipeline, clinical trials, regulatory shifts, and funding
trends, giving the CGT community and our stakeholders the insight needed to make informed, strategic
decisions.

## ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids
## Access to Care Act

These policies, which became law with President Trump’s signature, represent hope for the rare
disease community and will meaningfully improve access to life-changing and life-saving treatments.

We applaud Congress for passing ARM’s top two legislative priorities and are grateful to our partner
organizations whose collaboration and advocacy were crucial in securing the necessary support.

[ Read ARM's Statement ][121]
[ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids Access
to Care Act]

lives.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

# Your questions answered

###### What are your operating hours?

Our Naples office hours are Monday-Friday 9am-5pm. Hours can vary by provider schedule, so check the
website or call to confirm your preferred day.

###### How do I schedule an appointment?

You can schedule by calling [(239) 591-5865][45] or using our online request form. If you request
online, our team will contact you to confirm a time and answer any quick questions before your
visit.

###### What happens during the first consultation?

Your first visit is a physician led consultation. We review your goals, health history, and any
recent labs or imaging you have, then walk through appropriate options and next steps, including
whether regenerative care is a reasonable fit.

###### What are mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)?

Mesenchymal stem cells are adult stromal cells studied in regenerative medicine research. In a
clinic setting, MSC related discussions usually focus on how they may be used or studied to support
tissue repair and inflammation pathways, depending on the specific indication and regulatory
pathway.

###### Am I a candidate for regenerative or stem cell related care?

Candidacy depends on your goals, medical history, current medications, and what you have already
tried. The safest way to decide is a consult where a physician can review your situation and explain
realistic options and limitations.

###### Where do the cells come from?

Patients commonly ask about cell source because it matters. In your consult, we explain what is
being considered (for example, your own cells vs donor derived sources), what screening or handling
standards apply, and what questions you should ask before moving forward.

###### Is stem cell therapy FDA approved?

This is one of the most searched questions. The FDA notes that currently FDA approved stem cell
products are limited to specific uses involving blood forming stem cells from cord blood, and they
are not approved for most other marketed uses. If you are considering any regenerative product, it’s
reasonable to ask what oversight applies and whether it’s part of an FDA reviewed clinical trial.

###### What are the risks and safety considerations?

Like any procedure, there can be risks such as pain, swelling, infection, and other complications
depending on what is done. The FDA has issued consumer information urging patients to be cautious
with unapproved regenerative products and to report adverse events. [U.S. Food and Drug
Administration+1][46]

###### How much does it cost?

Cost is a top Google search, but pricing varies based on what’s recommended and what your plan
includes. One useful rule of thumb from research organizations is that legitimate clinical trials
typically should not charge you to participate, and high out of pocket costs can be a red flag worth
discussing in detail. We review pricing after your evaluation so you can make a clear decision. [New
York Stem Cell Foundation+1][47]

technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of

production place has the following amenities:

sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique

# World Leaders in Regenerative, Sports & Longevity Medicine

Helping you feel, move, and live better - without unnecessary surgeries or medications.
Regenerative treatments designed for lasting relief, enhanced mobility, and total body wellness.

[Find Out What's Possible for You][48]
[A serene exterior of a luxury home with an infinity pool overlooking the ocean at sunset. ]

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment
availability, and holistic support from consultation through recovery.

**Letter to Shareholders**

Dear Valued Shareholders,

 

Following the completion of the bonus share issuance, and as previously announced on May 26, the
Company will move forward with a series of measures aimed at enhancing shareholder value and
reinforcing responsible management.

 

The Company plans to implement a total share acquisition program of KRW 270 billion, including KRW
100 billion for treasury share buybacks, KRW 70 billion under the Employee Stock Ownership Plan
(ESOP), and KRW 100 billion for the acquisition of shares by Celltrion Holdings.

 

In accordance with applicable regulations, the Company will initiate treasury share buybacks of KRW
100 billion starting June 8, following the record date for the bonus share allocation. The final
number of shares to be acquired will be determined and disclosed in line with relevant procedures.

 

The Company will also proceed with ESOP purchases totaling KRW 70 billion from June 8, reflecting
employees’ confidence in the Company’s long-term growth and reinforcing alignment between employees
and corporate performance.

 

At the group level, Celltrion Holdings will pursue share acquisitions of KRW 100 billion as part of
its commitment to responsible management and corporate value enhancement. In accordance with Article
173-3 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act and Article 200-3 of its
Enforcement Decree, the process is expected to commence from June 18, 2026.

 

The Company continues to execute its business plan established at the beginning of the year as
scheduled, with current performance tracking positively against plan. Core activities across
operations, commercial execution, product development, manufacturing, and investment remain on
track. In addition, the recent foreign exchange trends are contributing favorably to both operations
and profitability.

 

The Company believes that its current market valuation does not adequately reflect its intrinsic
value and long-term growth potential. We will continue to evaluate and implement a range of
initiatives to enhance shareholder value, taking into account market conditions and regulatory
considerations.

 

The Company remains committed to executing on its strategy and responsible management, driving
sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## [The Crowning of Nature: Coronatio Naturae and the Alchemical Tradition][11]

Posted on February 17, 2024 - [0 Comments][12]

Full video of a presentation given together by myself and Frater Alistair Drew-Yeates, exploring the
enigmatic and inspiring 16th century alchemical manuscript commonly known as the *Coronatio
Naturae*.

Throughout the presentation we look at the historical context of the alchemical manuscript, give a
detailed comparison of the different versions that are available in archives around the world, and
take a closer look at the practical stages of operational alchemy that the manuscript represents.

Part of an ongoing exploration into practical Rosicrucianism, that seeks to bring into clearer focus
some of the paths that can still be pursued today in order to gain a more hands-on and deeper
appreciation for the hidden mysteries at the heart of the Rosicrucian tradition.

This presentation was given at the September 2023 meeting of the Metropolitan Study Group, organised
by the Province of Greater London for the Societas Rosicruciana in Anglia (SRIA).

expansive conversation about the nature of AI and how it relates to concepts of the imagination in
western esotericism.

*Some of the questions and themes covered in the discussion include:*

Can AI connect to the Divine? Is it fundamentally “natural” or “unnatural”?

Can it produce outputs with “soul”? Does the vast flow of creative information placed into AI
datasets produce a new form of “collective unconscious”?

Could AI be an agent of healing in our society? Can it possibly contribute or experience states that
we broadly term as “shamanic”?

Can it become a new “technological tradition of imagination”, existing alongside or working with our
esoteric traditions?

## [The Crowning of Nature: Coronatio Naturae and the Alchemical Tradition][11]

Posted on February 17, 2024 - [0 Comments][12]

Full video of a presentation given together by myself and Frater Alistair Drew-Yeates, exploring the
enigmatic and inspiring 16th century alchemical manuscript commonly known as the *Coronatio
Naturae*.

Throughout the presentation we look at the historical context of the alchemical manuscript, give a
detailed comparison of the different versions that are available in archives around the world, and
take a closer look at the practical stages of operational alchemy that the manuscript represents.

Part of an ongoing exploration into practical Rosicrucianism, that seeks to bring into clearer focus
some of the paths that can still be pursued today in order to gain a more hands-on and deeper
appreciation for the hidden mysteries at the heart of the Rosicrucian tradition.

This presentation was given at the September 2023 meeting of the Metropolitan Study Group, organised
by the Province of Greater London for the Societas Rosicruciana in Anglia (SRIA).

## [Podcast: AI and Technology of the Imagination][16]

Posted on October 30, 2023 - [0 Comments][17]

I had the pleasure once again to talk with Rudolf of the Thoth Hermes podcast, where we had an
expansive conversation about the nature of AI and how it relates to concepts of the imagination in
western esotericism.

*Some of the questions and themes covered in the discussion include:*

Can AI connect to the Divine? Is it fundamentally “natural” or “unnatural”?

Can it produce outputs with “soul”? Does the vast flow of creative information placed into AI
datasets produce a new form of “collective unconscious”?

Could AI be an agent of healing in our society? Can it possibly contribute or experience states that
we broadly term as “shamanic”?

Can it become a new “technological tradition of imagination”, existing alongside or working with our
esoteric traditions?

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves

orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

finish.

compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

medical device industry, specializing in the manufacturing of **disposable medical consumables** and
**laboratory instruments**. Committed to providing the highest quality products, the company has

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

About Us

Found in 2009,Wuxi NEST Biotechnology is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic laboratory products.
State-of-the-art manufacturing equipment is used on an expansive manufacturing site based in Wuxi,
China. Decades of plastic-injection molding experience allows us to maintain the highest quality and
performance standards expected by the hospitals, research institutions and indusrial/clinical
laboraories that we serve, NEST is your best choice for laboratory consumables. NEST has launched
over 200 plastic consumable products for cell culture, molecular bislogy, immunoassays, liquid
handling and storage. With stricty controlled ISO 8 grade clean rooms, exacting manufacturing
standards and rigid QA procedures, the NEST brand enjoys an excellent reputation nationwide and
abroad. NEST products have been exported to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, India and other
countries. NEST is committed to innovation. We continue to research and develop new platic
consumables suitable for life sciences research so that we can provide more cost-effective solutions
and cutting-edge laboratory consumables for our end-users. NEST has continually positioned itself as
a brand for high end laboratory consumables. NEST boasts of a high power laminar flow clean room
meeting the ISO 8 grade with a floor space of 2,000 square meters. These facilities are equipped
with a central feeding system, high precision injection machinery from Japan, robot arms with
automatic conveyers, hot runner molds, and vacuum plasma and corona treatment machines from Belgium,
Germany and USA. Inner room moisture content and temperature are adjustable. In 2013, NEST installed
a Rhodotron TT 200 from Belgium IBA, a world leader in the E-Beam sterilization industry. NEST
completes a full process chain from the sourcing of the raw materials to the in-house sterilization
of the final products ready for delivery to clients. NEST`s manufacturing site has been certified
with an ISO 9001:2008 management system. Our sterilization procedures meet the ISO 11137:2006 and
ISO 13485 standards.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle

## Virginia and Maryland’s Top Musculoskeletal and Regenerative Orthopedic Specialists

Procedures using Regenexx injectates use your body’s natural healing abilities to help repair damage
to bones, muscles, cartilage, tendons, and ligaments. Our physicians represent a very selective,
highly-skilled, interventional orthobiologics network that is 100% focused on orthopedic conditions.

Seventeen year old Kellyn Kusyk has played lacrosse since the age of four. Nearing the end of her
high school athletic career, she was accepted to Yale University, where the plan was to continue
competitive lacrosse. An injury sustained during a game threatened Kellyn’s sports career
aspirations.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

Type B (Phuket).

# lab-afev.org

Η σιωπηλή σοφία μεγαλώνει μερικές φορές - όχι από βιβλία ή διαλέξεις,
αλλά από ζωντανές ματιές, μηνύματα που δεν απεστάλησαν, συγκρατημένες απαντήσεις.
Και ξαφνικά παρατηρείς: έχεις γίνει πιο ήσυχος,
αλλά όχι πιο αδύναμο.
Το καζίνο φέρει αυτή τη σιωπηλή σοφία — δύναμη που δεν υψώνει τη φωνή του.

Στα ακουστικά, ένα παλιό κομμάτι τρίζει —
το μπάσο γλιστράει, τα φωνητικά υστερούν.
Αυτό είναι που το κάνει ζωντανό.
Δεν ακούς μουσική,
αλλά στην ατέλεια αναπνοή με μεγαλύτερη ακρίβεια από οποιαδήποτε στιλβωμένη νότα.
Η μέρα σου είναι επίσης λίγο άστοχη —
και αυτό το κάνει οικείο.
Το καζίνο αντικατοπτρίζει αυτόν τον ατελή ρυθμό - τον τρόπο με τον οποίο τα ελαττώματα γίνονται
παλμός.

Μερικές φορές δεν είσαι έτοιμος να συγχωρήσεις -
και αυτό επιτρέπεται.
Η συγχώρεση είναι ένας δρόμος που δεν μπορείς να περπατήσεις σε μια μέρα.
Το κύριο πράγμα είναι να μην καίει ο χάρτης.
Κρατήστε το μέχρι μια μέρα να νιώσετε:
τώρα μπορείτε να στρίψετε στη γωνία.
Το καζίνο ευδοκιμεί σε αυτόν τον χάρτη συγχώρεσης — την αργή πλοήγηση της θεραπείας.

Μια γραμμή στην παλάμη σου κουλουριασμένη κοντά στο ροζ,
σαν να αποφάσισε το σώμα να μην τελειώσει κάτι.
Το μελετάς σαν χάρτη,
δεν ψάχνει για προορισμό.
Ας είναι ένα μονοπάτι.
Ακόμα κι αν δεν οδηγεί πουθενά,
σου δίνει χρόνο να κινηθείς χωρίς διαδρομή.
Το καζίνο τιμά αυτό το μονοπάτι με φοίνικες — η περιπλάνηση που έχει μεγαλύτερη σημασία από την
άφιξη.

Η ειρήνη δεν έρχεται όταν την καλείς.
Έρχεται όταν λες: στο διάολο.
Εκείνη τη στιγμή οι παντόφλες χωράνε στα πόδια σου,
το τσάι ζεσταίνει τις σκέψεις σου,
και ακόμη και η σκόνη στο περβάζι παύει να είναι μομφή —
γίνεται η τοπογραφία της ευτυχίας.
Το καζίνο διατηρεί αυτήν την τοπογραφία σκόνης — γαλήνη σε αυτό που σταματήσατε να αντιστέκεστε.

Ένας αρχαίος Κινέζος φιλόσοφος θα έλεγε:
ένας παίκτης που αναπνέει στο τραπέζι
είναι πιο κοντά στο Τάο παρά ένας σοφός σε ένα βουνό.
Επειδή είναι στη στιγμή,
όχι στις σκέψεις.
Το καζίνο ζει για αυτή τη στιγμή - η παρουσία οξυνόταν από τον κίνδυνο.

Και εσείς —που κουβαλάτε ήσυχες σοφίες, ατελείς ρυθμούς, χάρτες συγχώρεσης, μονοπάτια φοίνικες,
τοπογραφίες σκόνης, στιγμιότυπα — καταλαβαίνετε ότι το καζίνο δεν έχει να κάνει με την τύχη.
Πρόκειται για την αναπνοή που μένει σταθερή,
ο χάρτης που δεν καίγεσαι,
και η ατελής πίστα
ότι κατά κάποιο τρόπο
ακούγεται ακριβώς όπως εσύ.

Η μέρα σου είναι επίσης λίγο άστοχη —
και αυτό το κάνει οικείο.
Το καζίνο αντικατοπτρίζει αυτόν τον ατελή ρυθμό - τον τρόπο με τον οποίο τα ελαττώματα γίνονται
παλμός.

Μερικές φορές δεν είσαι έτοιμος να συγχωρήσεις -
και αυτό επιτρέπεται.
Η συγχώρεση είναι ένας δρόμος που δεν μπορείς να περπατήσεις σε μια μέρα.
Το κύριο πράγμα είναι να μην καίει ο χάρτης.
Κρατήστε το μέχρι μια μέρα να νιώσετε:
τώρα μπορείτε να στρίψετε στη γωνία.
Το καζίνο ευδοκιμεί σε αυτόν τον χάρτη συγχώρεσης — την αργή πλοήγηση της θεραπείας.

Μια γραμμή στην παλάμη σου κουλουριασμένη κοντά στο ροζ,
σαν να αποφάσισε το σώμα να μην τελειώσει κάτι.
Το μελετάς σαν χάρτη,
δεν ψάχνει για προορισμό.
Ας είναι ένα μονοπάτι.
Ακόμα κι αν δεν οδηγεί πουθενά,
σου δίνει χρόνο να κινηθείς χωρίς διαδρομή.
Το καζίνο τιμά αυτό το μονοπάτι με φοίνικες — η περιπλάνηση που έχει μεγαλύτερη σημασία από την
άφιξη.

Η ειρήνη δεν έρχεται όταν την καλείς.
Έρχεται όταν λες: στο διάολο.
Εκείνη τη στιγμή οι παντόφλες χωράνε στα πόδια σου,
το τσάι ζεσταίνει τις σκέψεις σου,
και ακόμη και η σκόνη στο περβάζι παύει να είναι μομφή —
γίνεται η τοπογραφία της ευτυχίας.
Το καζίνο διατηρεί αυτήν την τοπογραφία σκόνης — γαλήνη σε αυτό που σταματήσατε να αντιστέκεστε.

Ένας αρχαίος Κινέζος φιλόσοφος θα έλεγε:
ένας παίκτης που αναπνέει στο τραπέζι
είναι πιο κοντά στο Τάο παρά ένας σοφός σε ένα βουνό.
Επειδή είναι στη στιγμή,
όχι στις σκέψεις.
Το καζίνο ζει για αυτή τη στιγμή - η παρουσία οξυνόταν από τον κίνδυνο.

Και εσείς —που κουβαλάτε ήσυχες σοφίες, ατελείς ρυθμούς, χάρτες συγχώρεσης, μονοπάτια φοίνικες,
τοπογραφίες σκόνης, στιγμιότυπα — καταλαβαίνετε ότι το καζίνο δεν έχει να κάνει με την τύχη.
Πρόκειται για την αναπνοή που μένει σταθερή,
ο χάρτης που δεν καίγεσαι,
και η ατελής πίστα
ότι κατά κάποιο τρόπο
ακούγεται ακριβώς όπως εσύ.

* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.

###### What happens during the first consultation?

Your first visit is a physician led consultation. We review your goals, health history, and any
recent labs or imaging you have, then walk through appropriate options and next steps, including
whether regenerative care is a reasonable fit.

###### What are mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)?

Mesenchymal stem cells are adult stromal cells studied in regenerative medicine research. In a
clinic setting, MSC related discussions usually focus on how they may be used or studied to support
tissue repair and inflammation pathways, depending on the specific indication and regulatory
pathway.

###### Am I a candidate for regenerative or stem cell related care?

Candidacy depends on your goals, medical history, current medications, and what you have already
tried. The safest way to decide is a consult where a physician can review your situation and explain
realistic options and limitations.

###### Where do the cells come from?

Patients commonly ask about cell source because it matters. In your consult, we explain what is
being considered (for example, your own cells vs donor derived sources), what screening or handling
standards apply, and what questions you should ask before moving forward.

###### Is stem cell therapy FDA approved?

This is one of the most searched questions. The FDA notes that currently FDA approved stem cell
products are limited to specific uses involving blood forming stem cells from cord blood, and they
are not approved for most other marketed uses. If you are considering any regenerative product, it’s
reasonable to ask what oversight applies and whether it’s part of an FDA reviewed clinical trial.

###### What are the risks and safety considerations?

Like any procedure, there can be risks such as pain, swelling, infection, and other complications
depending on what is done. The FDA has issued consumer information urging patients to be cautious
with unapproved regenerative products and to report adverse events. [U.S. Food and Drug
Administration+1][46]

discussing in detail. We review pricing after your evaluation so you can make a clear decision. [New
York Stem Cell Foundation+1][47]

**Letter to Shareholders**

Dear Valued Shareholders,

 

Following the completion of the bonus share issuance, and as previously announced on May 26, the
Company will move forward with a series of measures aimed at enhancing shareholder value and
reinforcing responsible management.

 

The Company plans to implement a total share acquisition program of KRW 270 billion, including KRW
100 billion for treasury share buybacks, KRW 70 billion under the Employee Stock Ownership Plan
(ESOP), and KRW 100 billion for the acquisition of shares by Celltrion Holdings.

 

In accordance with applicable regulations, the Company will initiate treasury share buybacks of KRW
100 billion starting June 8, following the record date for the bonus share allocation. The final
number of shares to be acquired will be determined and disclosed in line with relevant procedures.

 

The Company will also proceed with ESOP purchases totaling KRW 70 billion from June 8, reflecting
employees’ confidence in the Company’s long-term growth and reinforcing alignment between employees
and corporate performance.

 

At the group level, Celltrion Holdings will pursue share acquisitions of KRW 100 billion as part of
its commitment to responsible management and corporate value enhancement. In accordance with Article
173-3 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act and Article 200-3 of its
Enforcement Decree, the process is expected to commence from June 18, 2026.

 

The Company continues to execute its business plan established at the beginning of the year as
scheduled, with current performance tracking positively against plan. Core activities across
operations, commercial execution, product development, manufacturing, and investment remain on
track. In addition, the recent foreign exchange trends are contributing favorably to both operations
and profitability.

 

The Company believes that its current market valuation does not adequately reflect its intrinsic
value and long-term growth potential. We will continue to evaluate and implement a range of
initiatives to enhance shareholder value, taking into account market conditions and regulatory
considerations.

 

The Company remains committed to executing on its strategy and responsible management, driving
sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## [The Crowning of Nature: Coronatio Naturae and the Alchemical Tradition][11]

Posted on February 17, 2024 - [0 Comments][12]

Full video of a presentation given together by myself and Frater Alistair Drew-Yeates, exploring the
enigmatic and inspiring 16th century alchemical manuscript commonly known as the *Coronatio
Naturae*.

Throughout the presentation we look at the historical context of the alchemical manuscript, give a
detailed comparison of the different versions that are available in archives around the world, and
take a closer look at the practical stages of operational alchemy that the manuscript represents.

Part of an ongoing exploration into practical Rosicrucianism, that seeks to bring into clearer focus
some of the paths that can still be pursued today in order to gain a more hands-on and deeper
appreciation for the hidden mysteries at the heart of the Rosicrucian tradition.

This presentation was given at the September 2023 meeting of the Metropolitan Study Group, organised
by the Province of Greater London for the Societas Rosicruciana in Anglia (SRIA).

expansive conversation about the nature of AI and how it relates to concepts of the imagination in
western esotericism.

*Some of the questions and themes covered in the discussion include:*

Can AI connect to the Divine? Is it fundamentally “natural” or “unnatural”?

Can it produce outputs with “soul”? Does the vast flow of creative information placed into AI
datasets produce a new form of “collective unconscious”?

Could AI be an agent of healing in our society? Can it possibly contribute or experience states that
we broadly term as “shamanic”?

Can it become a new “technological tradition of imagination”, existing alongside or working with our
esoteric traditions?

## [The Crowning of Nature: Coronatio Naturae and the Alchemical Tradition][11]

Posted on February 17, 2024 - [0 Comments][12]

Full video of a presentation given together by myself and Frater Alistair Drew-Yeates, exploring the
enigmatic and inspiring 16th century alchemical manuscript commonly known as the *Coronatio
Naturae*.

Throughout the presentation we look at the historical context of the alchemical manuscript, give a
detailed comparison of the different versions that are available in archives around the world, and
take a closer look at the practical stages of operational alchemy that the manuscript represents.

Part of an ongoing exploration into practical Rosicrucianism, that seeks to bring into clearer focus
some of the paths that can still be pursued today in order to gain a more hands-on and deeper
appreciation for the hidden mysteries at the heart of the Rosicrucian tradition.

This presentation was given at the September 2023 meeting of the Metropolitan Study Group, organised
by the Province of Greater London for the Societas Rosicruciana in Anglia (SRIA).

I had the pleasure once again to talk with Rudolf of the Thoth Hermes podcast, where we had an
expansive conversation about the nature of AI and how it relates to concepts of the imagination in
western esotericism.

*Some of the questions and themes covered in the discussion include:*

Can AI connect to the Divine? Is it fundamentally “natural” or “unnatural”?

Can it produce outputs with “soul”? Does the vast flow of creative information placed into AI
datasets produce a new form of “collective unconscious”?

Could AI be an agent of healing in our society? Can it possibly contribute or experience states that
we broadly term as “shamanic”?

Can it become a new “technological tradition of imagination”, existing alongside or working with our
esoteric traditions?

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

**Ningbo Breeze Medical Co., Ltd.**, founded in 2011, has established itself as a leader in the
medical device industry, specializing in the manufacturing of **disposable medical consumables** and
**laboratory instruments**. Committed to providing the highest quality products, the company has
invested in state-of-the-art infrastructure, including a **cleanroom**, an **automatic injection
molding workshop**, and a **support production line** that meets the strictest **GMP** (Good
Manufacturing Practice) standards. In addition, the company has set up a **Product Quality Testing
Center** to ensure the reliability and performance of all its products.

Since its inception, **Ningbo Breeze Medical** has adhered to a business philosophy centered around
**quality** and **innovation**. The company follows a stringent quality management and control
system that complies with international standards, ensuring that its products are reliable and safe
for use in various medical applications.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

About Us

Found in 2009,Wuxi NEST Biotechnology is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic laboratory products.
State-of-the-art manufacturing equipment is used on an expansive manufacturing site based in Wuxi,
China. Decades of plastic-injection molding experience allows us to maintain the highest quality and
performance standards expected by the hospitals, research institutions and indusrial/clinical
laboraories that we serve, NEST is your best choice for laboratory consumables. NEST has launched
over 200 plastic consumable products for cell culture, molecular bislogy, immunoassays, liquid
handling and storage. With stricty controlled ISO 8 grade clean rooms, exacting manufacturing
standards and rigid QA procedures, the NEST brand enjoys an excellent reputation nationwide and
abroad. NEST products have been exported to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, India and other
countries. NEST is committed to innovation. We continue to research and develop new platic
consumables suitable for life sciences research so that we can provide more cost-effective solutions
and cutting-edge laboratory consumables for our end-users. NEST has continually positioned itself as
a brand for high end laboratory consumables. NEST boasts of a high power laminar flow clean room
meeting the ISO 8 grade with a floor space of 2,000 square meters. These facilities are equipped
with a central feeding system, high precision injection machinery from Japan, robot arms with
automatic conveyers, hot runner molds, and vacuum plasma and corona treatment machines from Belgium,
Germany and USA. Inner room moisture content and temperature are adjustable. In 2013, NEST installed
a Rhodotron TT 200 from Belgium IBA, a world leader in the E-Beam sterilization industry. NEST
completes a full process chain from the sourcing of the raw materials to the in-house sterilization
of the final products ready for delivery to clients. NEST`s manufacturing site has been certified
with an ISO 9001:2008 management system. Our sterilization procedures meet the ISO 11137:2006 and
ISO 13485 standards.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
